messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++14 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#include<math.h>

using namespace std;

#define fast ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);cin.tie(NULL);cout.tie(NULL);
#define pb push_back
#define pf push_front
#define mp make_pair
#define mt make_tuple
#define popb pop_back
#define popf pop_front
#define int long long int
#define PI 3.1415926535897932
#define all(v) v.begin(),v.end()
#define endl "\n"
#define rep(i,a,b)  for(int i=a;i<b;i++)
#define prec(x)  cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x)
#define toup(su) transform(su.begin(), su.end(), su.begin(), ::toupper); 
#define tolow(su) transform(su.begin(), su.end(), su.begin(), ::tolower); 
int M=1000000007;

int gcd(int a, int b)
{
  return (b==0)?a:gcd(b,a%b);
}

int main()
{
    fast
    //freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
    //freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
    int t=1;
    //cin>>t;
    while(t--)
    {
        double x,y,n; cin>>x>>y>>n;
        int a,b;
        double req=(x/y);
        double now, diff;
        double mn=1e9;
        int num;
        if(y<=n)
        {
            a=x; b=y;
        }
        else
        {
            for(int i=n;i>=1;i--)
            {
                int deno =i;
                double z=(double(deno)*req);

                if(z-floor(z)<=0.5) num=floor(z);

                else 
                    num=floor(z)+1;

                now=double(num)/deno;

                diff= abs(now-req);

                if(diff<=mn)
                {
                    mn=diff; a=num; b=deno;
                }

            }
        }
        int g=gcd(a,b);
        a=a/g;
        b=b/g;

        cout<<a<<"/"<<b<<endl;

    }
    return 0;   
}
